plan_review.notes: Plan review approved with changes. Concern 2: distinguish narrow local fingerprint from final covered fingerprint and prefer gitignored files/ paths; adopted by keeping /tmp only for temporary pre-edit artifact, planning a full covered fingerprint check for the accepted change, and noting broad sweeps stay on GitHub/CI.

findings.detail: Inlined Size half-extent resolution duplicates getBodyHalfWidth/getBodyHalfHeight without a lockstep test. Existing collision tests cover common circle spawns and would pass before/after; they would not catch future helper/inline drift (e.g. box-only or zero-size shim paths). Smallest remedy: one unit test that builds box, circle, and zero-size fixtures, runs collisionSystem, and asserts inserted half-extents match the helpers (and shim stats still increment only on the zero-size path).

independent_grade.notes: The production diff surgically inlines the established Size half-extent precedence (half axis, else radius, else helper/shim) inside collisionSystem’s insert loop, preserving semantics while avoiding two helper calls on the common valid-Size path. Edge cases match the helpers for practical Float32 Size values; gameplay neutrality is supported by the reported identical covered RunStats hash. Scope is tight (one hot-path file plus required 3🍎 ceremony). Policy is clean: core-only, deterministic, no new system/wiring, no Date.now/Math.random. Test coverage is adequate-but-thin: behavior is exercised by existing collision/ECS tests and external fingerprint checks, but the new inlined branches are not locked to the helpers by a failing-without-it regression test. Maintainability is good with mild duplication risk. No blocker-severity issues; verdict is pass.
